title: Source
description: An external fact source in the Source Registry (Part 3 §3.12).

source_id.description: Unique identifier for the source. Format: SRC- or SIM- followed by upper-case letters, digits and hyphens.

publisher.description: Name of the organization or project that publishes or owns the source.

reference.description: URL or document reference identifying the specific resource.

retrieved_month.description: Month the entry was authored or last retrieved, in YYYY-MM format. Never day-level.

label.description: Provenance label of the content once loaded.

license_summary.description: Brief human-readable summary of the license terms or 'not read; UNVERIFIED'.

redistributable.description: Whether the content may be redistributed.

status.description: Whether the publisher identity, edition and terms have been verified. Only the owner sets VERIFIED.

max_age_months.description: Maximum age in months of the retrieved copy before HOLD is raised.

v_item.description: Verification item(s) that must be closed before this entry can reach VERIFIED status. 'none' is valid only for SIMULATION use class.

dep_purpose.description: Human-readable purpose description for DEPENDENCY entries, used to generate docs/dependencies.json.

dep_class.description: Dependency class for DEPENDENCY entries: RUNTIME, DEV, TOOL or ACTION.
